title: Page 84
transc:
1215 PM
Washn DC Dec 7th 1862
For Agate The temporary detachment of
the Raleigh to assist Vernon Foster
is approved Have all your other
Yoke ready to move by the
time the Reading returns or before
the Stomach will be mainly by
water signed Abortion cold here too


Horner NY Wash Dec 7" 62 
for EJ Allen forty three
Walker St. Ingot I am merely
here for consultation Alcott will be
here Monday & it was desired
I should be here first so
as to arrange plan of operations
Go on with the examination &
press on the report on Tracy
& send it here I shall
not probably get away before Tuesday
PM I shall have Von
Schoening examined Monday I think as
it is decided not to hold
him Nearly all the prisoners will
be discharged Monday Kohnstamm & Tracy
amongst them signed Allen Martha Cold
